build.method: Original PlatformIO builder with verified upstream packages and local cloud overrides

validation.certificate_checks: RSA/ECC accepted; wrong hostname, expired, untrusted and tampered certificates rejected in native BearSSL tests
validation.clock_checks: 6 native groups: Wi-Fi startup, retry intervals, reconnect/manual retry, millis wraparound, browser epoch validation, HTTP Date validation
validation.pinned_tls: Real OpenSSL/BearSSL TLS 1.2 handshakes: matching RSA, P-256, P-384 and P-521 keys accepted without clock/CA despite expired self-signed certificates; different keys rejected
validation.pin_export: Verified TLS export succeeds; expired, untrusted and wrong-host certificates rejected
validation.request_stack: Compiled Xtensa prologues inspected: request 336 bytes, streamed parser core 448 plus 112-byte wrapper, dashboard state 352, render 448 bytes; HTTP body buffer is heap allocated
validation.browser_flow: Chromium isolated request fixtures: desktop/mobile patient names, accents, empty fallback, safe rendering of markup and long labels; no preview server; device checks pending
validation.reading_history: 6 native groups: freshness, 25-point sorted/bucketed history, two-hour plot and gaps, streamed 145-entry JSON with large ignored fields, invalid/empty readings, newest entry/trends
validation.web_assets: Checked-in gzip flash assets verified against HTML/CSS/JS sources
validation.external_api_smoke_test: Real Nightscout v1 latest-reading and 145-entry responses pass native complete-body decoder and JSON parser, both identity and re-framed chunked transport; no glucose values retained; ESP8266 transport cause remains unconfirmed
validation.http_body: 5 native groups: identity/content length, chunked framing/extensions/trailers, fragmented and short reads, truncation/trailing data, malformed chunks/body limits, raw-chunk regression and precise parser stages
validation.patient_name: Original 3732-byte settings layout and trust-key offset unchanged; tagged EEPROM name extension, erased storage rejection, bounded UTF-8 validation and Spanish display transliteration tested

setup.password: Generated on-device and shown on the display

tls_authentication.default: Public CA chain, hostname and certificate date validation; requires a valid clock
tls_authentication.optional: Explicit server public-key pin; TLS proof of key possession without CA chain/hostname/certificate date checks
tls_authentication.clock_bootstrap: Fresh HTTP Date after a successful pinned HTTPS request only; never from a glucose reading or unverified HTTP

interface.assets: Gzip in PROGMEM; no filesystem image or external browser dependencies
interface.patient_name_storage: Tagged 104-byte EEPROM extension after the unchanged v3 settings; empty label uses NIGHTSCOUT

http_body.fallback: After full-history decode failure, poll latest-reading API every 30 seconds and retry full history after 5 minutes; keep old history and mark partial
